name: Event Marker L4: Filter Pattern (Core Wiring Rule)
description: Tests L4 filter pattern: boolean filter as last input with table_is_filter=True. Two metric columns (DecimalFormat + PercentFormat) plus filter column.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
daily_range = (high - low) / close
is_triggered = rsi_14 > 65

event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(title='Overbought + Range', icon=Icon.ZapIcon, schemas=[
    ColumnSpec(title='RSI', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
    ColumnSpec(title='Range %', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
    ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
]))((rsi_14, daily_range, is_triggered))

xy_lines(title='RSI 14', category='Analysis', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
    LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Red)
]))(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_14)
